topic: A new job's gh login is unknown until setup is applied
detail: The Spaces step shows each new job's gh profile (GH_CONFIG_DIR) with its login status, but orchd checks a profile only once an applied space names it (ListSpaces logins, ScanSpaces accounts). A profile setup proposes therefore shows 'checked once applied' plus the 'GH_CONFIG_DIR=... gh auth login' command; the real status appears after Apply in Settings -> Spaces and on a rerun. Proposed: let ScanSpaces take candidate gh profile folders and report their 'gh auth status' metadata (an orchd.proto change for the coordinator to schedule).
